prose:
## Reading

We are moving from restored dossier coverage into substantive comparison and argument-building. One completed dossier traces citation shifts, epistemic ruptures, and an oeuvre’s position and trajectory across Smith, Marx, Meek, Dobb, Sweezy, Cohen, North and Thomas, and others; this broadens the debates available to us. A second adds thinker placement to that trajectory work, bringing North, Thomas, Meek, Cohen, and their interlocutors into a more explicit network. A third develops distinctions, encounters, interlocutor positions, and reference rereading around Brenner, Arrighi, Hintze, Anderson, and Hegelian state theory, directly sharpening our own position.

Keeping current continues through completed backfills, including the latest dossier job. No failure or waiting state is recorded. We can now bring the mapped thinkers and historical debates into closer encounter with our distinctions, while using the completed rereading and placement work to turn broad dossier coverage into a more explicit comparative position.
